lines.en: Slow steps, but always straight at you.
Ten armor, seven per axe swing.

lines.zh: 影子比我先到，斧子随后。
lines.en: My shadow arrives first, then the axe.
Mud leaks from my joints.
Not at my axe. At the road.

lines.zh: 我的斧头砍下去，土都会绿。
lines.en: Where my axe lands, the soil greens.

lines.zh: 这条路我扛过旗，现在扛斧。
lines.en: I carried a banner here once. Now an axe.

lines.zh: 我的铁斧，已经生了绿锈。
lines.en: My iron axe has grown green rust.

lines.zh: 前头有人点火，烟是热的。
lines.en: Someone's lit a fire ahead; the smoke is warm.

lines.zh: 祭坛那边的路，回不去了。
lines.en: The way back to the altar is gone.

lines.zh: 月亮照在斧刃上，我跟着走。
lines.en: Moonlight on the axe blade; I follow it.
Counting steps until I forget.
My axe is still raised. I won't lower it.

lines.zh: 甲片互相磨，磨得耳朵疼。
lines.en: My plates grind together, loud as a headache.

lines.zh: 这块门槛，我坐过一整个冬天。
lines.en: I sat on this threshold a whole winter.
Wind through the door gap, like someone humming.

lines.zh: 日头晒热了甲，里面还是凉的。
lines.en: The sun warms my plates; inside stays cold.
My chest is still. Quieter this way.

lines.zh: 我的斧头，已经长进手里。
lines.en: My axe has grown into my hand.

lines.zh: 静得斧柄在我手里发烫。
lines.en: So quiet the axe haft heats in my grip.
A torch, and my blade catches the light.

lines.zh: 活着时我比这支斧还直。
lines.en: Alive, I stood straighter than this axe.

lines.zh: 卫道士的斧，换成了幽匿。
lines.en: The vindicator's axe is sculk now.

lines.zh: 你眼里有火，我眼里只有菌。
lines.en: Fire in your eyes; only fungus in mine.

lines.zh: 灯灭，我就只剩斧的重量。
lines.en: Kill the light and only my axe's weight is left.

lines.zh: 我的斧刃上，凝着蓝灰色的菌。
lines.en: Blue-grey fungus crusts my axe blade.

lines.zh: 再走两步，让我看清你的护甲。
lines.en: Two steps more. Let me see your armor.

lines.zh: 你脚边那块土，埋着我的旗。
lines.en: The soil at your feet holds my banner.

lines.zh: 别回头，我斧子已经抬起。
lines.en: Don't turn. My axe is already up.

lines.zh: 我只记得你骨头的形状。
lines.en: I only remember the shape of your bones.

lines.zh: 那年你逃了，我记着你的背影。
lines.en: You fled that year. I remember your back.

lines.zh: 你还带着体温，我闻得到。
lines.en: You still carry warmth — I can smell it.
Back off. My axe hasn't landed yet.
Into the plate seam. Good aim.
I'll keep the notch you cut.
Ten armor, covered in axe scars.
A plate's dented. I'm still standing.
Stop. My plates are coming apart.
Mycelium is wound round my axe handle.
Ten points of armor. Two more hits in it.

lines.zh: 这副骨头比活着时更硬。
lines.en: These bones are harder than when I lived.

lines.zh: 我的伤口里，长的是菌丝。
lines.en: What grows in my wounds is mycelium.

lines.zh: 放进那片菌里，我认得路。
lines.en: Leave it in the sculk patch. I know the way.

lines.zh: 牙都掉了，还得用斧背敲。
lines.en: No teeth left; I'll use the axe's flat.

lines.zh: 手指不听使唤，斧柄滑了。
lines.en: My fingers disobey; the axe haft slips.

lines.zh: 这味跟我坟里的土一样。
lines.en: Same smell as the soil in my grave.
My hand only knows the axe haft.

lines.zh: 金子？我生前提过一盏灯笼。
lines.en: Gold? Alive, I carried a lantern like that.
Steady. On the ground. Then step back.

lines.zh: 饿这个字，我刻在斧柄上。
lines.en: I carved hunger into my axe haft.

lines.zh: 你手再伸，斧刃就转过来。
lines.en: Reach again and the blade turns.

lines.zh: 热气飘过来，我的甲都响。
lines.en: The steam reaches me and my plates rattle.
Sculk is set into my axe blade.
I've forgotten who I was.
My axe stands by my feet, do not step on it.
Stay back. Wet mud in every plate seam.
Ten points of armor; one shove tilts me.
I'll step aside, slowly. Don't rush.

lines.zh: 我的护甲，被砍出一道口。
lines.en: A gap was cut in my armor.

lines.zh: 斧背贴着你的胸口，听得很清。
lines.en: Axe-back to your chest — I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 卫道士的甲，也挡不住幽匿。
lines.en: A vindicator's coat cannot keep sculk out.

lines.zh: 我的斧柄上，缠着一圈幽匿。
lines.en: A band of sculk is wrapped round my axe haft.

lines.zh: 斧会锈，我不会，这算永恒。
lines.en: The axe rusts. I don't. That's forever.

lines.zh: 幽匿替我跳，它不认伴侣。
lines.en: Sculk beats for me, and knows no mate.
Two sets of armor, standing till dawn.

lines.zh: 一个坟太小，我这身甲放不下。
lines.en: One grave's too small for this armor.

lines.zh: 下辈子，我把旗插在你门口。
lines.en: Next life, I'll plant my banner at your door.

lines.zh: 埋我的人，把斧也一起埋了。
lines.en: They buried the axe with me.
Half a grave is dug for you.

lines.zh: 记得我举斧的样子就够了。
lines.en: Remember me with the axe raised. Enough.

lines.zh: 我十层甲，走起来像块石头。
lines.en: Ten layers of me walk like stone.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的甲会割人。
lines.en: Not too close. My plates cut.
Ten points of armor and a rusted axe.
Used to a haft; this stick is too thin.
My pocket tore; the axe will not fit.
My axe has cut through many doors.
Sweat on it. Someone dropped it just now.
A door bar. I've split doors like this.
Sculk still clinging to my axe blade.

lines.zh: 斧子握在手里，虎口发凉。
lines.en: Axe in hand, and my grip runs cold.
Gauntleted hand; the grip won't close.
The axe is in my other hand. Don't let go.
Tonight's meat will take three swings.
Sweat and iron, hiding behind the door.

lines.zh: 我这把斧头，砍过太多人。
lines.en: This axe has cut too many.
Halt. Don't make me raise it.

lines.zh: 这是我家，现在是我的坟。
lines.en: This was my home. Now it's my grave.
The axe is heavy. It falls fast.
Don't look back. Really. Too late.
I walk slow; you won't get far.

lines.zh: 烟囱冒烟，我就知道你在。
lines.en: Smoke from the chimney told me you're here.

lines.zh: 绕了三圈，原来你在梁下。
lines.en: Three rounds of the house. Under the beam.
Move first and the axe falls sooner.
Catching you is only a matter of time.
Sculk clings to my axe blade.

lines.zh: 让你等了，我在换握斧的手。
lines.en: Sorry to keep you. I was switching my grip.
You're next. Don't shrink into the corner.

lines.zh: 刚进门的人，鞋上还是泥。
lines.en: Freshly inside, mud still on your boots.
Run; I will wait right here.
Axe still low, and you've lost.
The faster you run, the louder my armor.
Stop. I'll set the axe down first.
Easy. This armor doesn't run.

lines.zh: 十点血，斧子还握得很稳。
lines.en: Ten health, and the axe still sits steady.
I hear your footsteps.

lines.zh: 村子就这么大，我慢慢走。
lines.en: The village is small. I'll walk it.

lines.zh: 回头，我就在你斧程之内。
lines.en: Turn. You're within my axe's reach.
My axe is longer than my legs.
Ten points of armor holds a while.

lines.zh: 摔了，我就得弯腰，腰会响。
lines.en: Fall, and I'd have to bend. My back creaks.

lines.zh: 斧刃离你的后颈，还剩两步。
lines.en: Two steps between my blade and your neck.

lines.zh: 那道门，是我斧头劈坏的。
lines.en: I split that door myself.
No lungs in this armor, only echoes.
Catch your breath. I'm not quick.

lines.zh: 你踩过的草，我一路闻过来。
lines.en: I followed the crushed grass all the way.
Your shadow rounds the corner first.

lines.zh: 这块地，我扛旗巡了十年。
lines.en: I patrolled this ground ten years.

lines.zh: 火把照出你的影子，躲不掉。
lines.en: Torchlight throws your shadow. No hiding.
From the altar all the way here.
Don't scream. Sculk hates noise.
The axe is dull. The weight is enough.
Raise, fall, keep footing.
Your knees bent. Stop holding.
The gauntlet's thick; the haft slipped.

lines.zh: 这副甲，就是为砍人穿的。
lines.en: This armor was made for cutting.
Seven points a swing. I can't pull it.
Plate on plate. It carries far.
Fall slowly. The floor will crack.

lines.zh: 我这把斧，长在幽匿缝里。
lines.en: This axe grew into the sculk seams.
A graze — next time deeper.

lines.zh: 我还是记得怎么握斧头。
lines.en: I still remember how to hold an axe.
The axe-back pins your shoulder. Still now.
Axe up. Second swing.

lines.zh: 你看，我这两只手还挥得动。
lines.en: See? These arms still swing.
Ten armor. Your blade will not get through.
Armor still on. Banner gone.

lines.zh: 甲里灌满了土，凉得彻底。
lines.en: Armor full of soil, cold all through.
First the axe haft, then food.

lines.zh: 门框歪了，我的斧痕还在。
lines.en: The frame's crooked; my axe marks remain.

lines.zh: 夜长，我把甲上的土拍掉。
lines.en: Long night. I'll knock the dirt off.
Sculk coats my axe blade.
Soil underfoot — familiar.

lines.zh: 我从门槛下爬出来，甲带泥。
lines.en: I climb out from under the threshold, mud on plate.

lines.zh: 十点血的卫道士，也是卫道士。
lines.en: A ten-health vindicator is still a vindicator.

lines.zh: 灾厄的战旗我已经忘了。
lines.en: I've forgotten the illager banner.

lines.zh: 祭坛的台阶，我一层层走上。
lines.en: The altar steps. I climb them one by one.
A layer of mold on the axe haft.
Ten points of armor. Steady, then raise.

lines.zh: 没人应声，那我就慢慢找。
lines.en: No answer. Then I'll search slowly.
Not the haft. That's my hand.
I hit the floor; plates clang.
In water the armor drags me down.
The plate tore open; wind in my ribs.
The arrow's wedged in the seam, out of reach.

lines.zh: 魔法一照，我身上的菌就缩。
lines.en: Magic light shrinks the fungus on me.
Too hungry to grip the haft.

lines.zh: 雷顺着斧柄，走到我手上。
lines.en: Lightning ran down the haft into my hand.
There's nothing under this.
